notes.title: HOTFIX 0.5.2.2
notes.notes:
Fixed issue causing characters to not always despawn on death
Fixed issue causing despawned characters to not always despawning equipped gear
Fixed issue causing character to stand back up after being rendered unconscious
Fixed issue causing Endless Assault to save and Sandbox to not (they got flipped)
Fixed a typo causing many buffs/debuffs to not fire

notes.title: Update 0.5.2
notes.notes:
[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Massive construction cost rebalance.  
[*] Added Craft All and Craft Turn buttons to the crafting window.
[*] -Craft All will craft as many of the item as possible and wait further orders
[*] -Craft Turn will do the same as Craft All except automatically end your turn upon completion
[*] Added the active characters inventory to all building windows to make it easier to move items around without juggling multiple windows
[*] Merged the Equipment sheet into the inventory panel to again make it easier to mange your equipment
[*] Old equipment button will now open the character sheet
[*] Added several tool tips and help options
[*] Added Flanking -  A character is considered flanking if they are attacking their target from directly behind or one "side" to the left or right and can do up to double damage
[*] Added a short global cooldown to skills in combat to prevent skillspam
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing many different skills to put their experience gains in to blocking.
[*] Hopefully fixed a bug causing enemies to attack practically never
[*] Inventory now closes automatically when using a building blueprint
[*] Workers assigned to a task will have their worker window updated to reflect their current task properly
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.5 Save Your Game
notes.notes:
Additions
Added the ability to save and load your games.  This feature is only available in Sandbox mode (and the upcoming Campaign) and NOT for the Endless Assault Mode.
Saving occurs automatically at the end of every round.  In the future this will be adjustable to per turn/round/day/never autosave.

Added Two Game Modes: Endless Assault and Sandbox
Endless Assault:  You have given 7 other characters(plus you), a small fort, and a load of supplies.  You have one day to set up defenses before enemies spawn at midnight of every day and come for you. Slay as many as you can before being overrun.

Sandbox:  Build whatever you like without being harassed by enemies.

notes.title: Patch 0.4.4
notes.notes:
[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added several new graphics options to the options menu.
[*] Added auto detect for settings.
[*] Added save settings option to save all settings.
[*] Added a visible turn indicator over the character whose turn it currently is.
[*] Added a Build Turn button on the construction menu.  This will build out as many times a possible and either end your turn if the building isn't complete or wait for further instructions if it is.
[*] Added the resource quality system.  Higher quality resources create better items and structures.
[*] Added: Iron and Steel Kettle Helms
[*] Fully Added Heal, Fireball, and Lightning spells.
[*] Added Iceball spell.
[*] Fireball can set your target on fire once they have accumulated enough fire damage.  This can be put out by the character by attempting to douse it or by using a spell such as iceball on them.  Fire is capable of spreading to nearby characters or tiles if it gets out of hand.
[*] Iceball can freeze your target in place.  The frozen character will need to attempt use strength to break free of the ice or stay frozen until thawed.  Get a tile cold enough and it too will freeze.
[*] A massive amount of update Icon art.
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in the building system causing the wrong items to be used when calculating the buildings final quality
[*] Fixed character rotation using A/D to rotate left right.
[*] Combat window should now close properly when ending your turn.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.4.3
notes.notes:
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] New "final" terrain for the world.  It will of course receive several artwork and detail passes but the general layout for the starting area is now complete.
[*] Two new tree types
[*] Significantly larger world(went from ~10k navigation points to ~40k)
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing the camera to not set itself correctly when changing characters.
[/list]

Notes:
While there isn't a long list of changes with this patch, a lot of changes and optimizations have happened in the back-end in preparations for the upcoming Demo release.   Would love to get some feedback on overall performance and any janky areas of the map you come across.   As long as all goes well, we will release more navigable map space in the coming days along with the tutorial system and Chapter I of the campaign for testing and ironing out before the Demo and Next Fest.

Thank you all for your help so far!

notes.title: Patch 0.4.1
notes.notes:
[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Tile: Coal
[*] New Resource: Coal
[*] New Skills: Metallurgy, Cooking, Mansonry, Woodworking, and Leatherworking
[*] New Recipes: Iron Ingot, Steel Ingot - These can be made in the Workshop after building at least one smelter upgrade. 
[*] New Upgrade: Smelter - The smelter can built as an upgrade to the workshop and can be built as many times as there are open tiles around the workshop.
[*] Automation - You can now use your main character, or faction commander, to manage automation for your Workshop(soon every building).  By hiring a faction member,  you can assign them to automatically manufacture a specified item on their turn.  There are currently no notifications for when they run out of resources so they will need to be restocked often to keep them productive.  This will change in the next update.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Quit Game Prompt - Hitting ESC now prompts you to quit or cancel
[*] 
[/list]

[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.4.0
notes.notes:
[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] After Selecting your character you will now choose your own location to spawn.
[*] You now have up to 3 Civilians who spawn with you under your direct control.
[*] Sound effects to most gathering actions
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed out from the hexagon built world to a true Landscape system
[*] Pine tree graphical update
[*] All aggressive characters are gone for now
[*] Starting inventory adjusted to be more inline with the tutorial that is coming soon.
[*] You now start with Town Center and a Workshop blueprints.  From the workshop you can use paper to create the blueprints for the other buildings as well as walls and gates to surround your "town". 
[*] Blueprints will now disappear after use. 
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Characters now look at the resource they are gathering.
[/list]

notes.title: PATCH NOTES v0.3.7
notes.notes:
[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Weapon: 1 Handed Spear
[*] New Weapon: 2 Handed Spear
[*] New Weapon: Dagger
[*] New Weapon: Greatsword
[*] New Skill: Chop - Costly but devastating heavy weapon strike
[*] New Skill: Jab - Cheap low damage skill that will help finish off opponents
[*] New Skill: Swipe - Cheap low damage skill for spears
[*] New Tile: Water Tile - 20 Stamina to move onto.  Contains fish and water resources(cant yet pull either, coming in v0.4 World Building)
[*] Food System Added: Vitals are no longer replenished at the start of each turn for free.  You must equip food items to be used to refill you at the start of your turn.  Different foods will have different replenishment values but if you have no food at all it will start to take from your health at a rate of 1HP per 20 Stamina and 10 mana so be sure to watch your food supplies.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Attacks that had no reason to do mana damage should no longer do mana damage.
[*] Switching combat targets while already engaged with another character will no longer switch your character into unarmed combat mode
[*] Chaining together skills too quickly should no longer crash out the skills
[*] Fixed the massive delay when changing to peace mode from combat mode when unarmed before you can move.
[/list]

notes.title: PATCH NOTES 0.3.6
notes.notes:
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Combat backend refactor :  Combat calculations much more performant and more dynamic to allow for greater interaction between combatants
[*] Equipment panel now shows  amount of ammo equipped
[/list]

[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added new indicator on a tile to highlight selected character.  Faction friendly will show green and non-faction will show red.
[*]Added feedback for not enough mana or health to perform an action
[*]Added feedback for hotkeying a skill
[*]Added clamps on the camera to disallow it from going under the player or too far away
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
Magic based attacks now give intelligence XP instead of agility
Heal Skill icon returned
Vital HUD now updates when attacked
Unequipping ammo no longer unequips the weapon
Unequipping a ranged weapon now unequips the associated ammo
Spawned ammo holders now despawn when the associated weapon is unequipped
Starting a turn will now return the correct amount of lost stamina and mana
Combat window should now close when another tile is selected to move to
Character now looks at the new target if already in combat with one enemy and a new one is chosen
NPC attacks no longer always do maximum possible damage on hit
Arrows now actually do and display damage on hit
